sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
अथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः ।
अनिच्छन्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः ॥ ३-३६॥
iast:
arjuna uvāca
atha kena prayukto’yaṃ pāpaṃ carati pūruṣaḥ
anicchannapi vārṣṇeya balādiva niyojitaḥ 3-36
translation: Arjuna said: But, by what impelled does man commit sin, though against his wishes, O Varshneya, constrained, as it were, by force?
